bibliographic.title: Demon Hunter: Legacy
bibliographic.author: RetroVem
bibliographic.description:
Immerse yourself in this short dark fantasy CYOA style text adventure where every decision shapes your fate. Choose your path wisely as you engage in battles, attribute trials, and strategic choices in a desperate quest to rescue your daughter from the infamous Blood Countess, Bathory.

🛡️ Create Your Hero – Customize your character by picking a class.
⚔️ Fight Terrifying Monsters
📖 Your Story, Your Legacy – The world remembers your deeds—whether as a savior or a legend shrouded in darkness.
🔄 Full Player Control – Save, reload, restart, or even turn back a page at almost any time!

Created in Twine by RetroVem
